","type":"text/x-markdown"},"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/README.md":{"title":"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/README.md","text":"# kind streams Bridges [Streams](https://github.com/saqimtiaz/streams) and the [kind](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-kind) schema engine so that individual Streams *nodes* can be turned into typed kind instances, marked as such, and edited — all from inside the Streams outline. ## What it does - **Identify** — every Streams node with a `kind.type` shows a small pill with its type key, plus a subtle row accent. - **Edit in place** — click the pill to expand kind's compact field bar for that node (click a field to edit; toggle inline/popup). The bar renders *lazily*, only for the node you open. - **Assign a type** — right-click any node → **Kind type ▸** opens a flyout submenu (styled like the Streams menu) listing the kind types; pick one to set, change (✓ marks the current) or remove its `kind.type`. - **Extend rows** — other plugins can add something to every row by tagging a tiddler `$:/tags/rimir/kind-streams/row-addon` (used by [rimir/streams-ports](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-streams-ports) for port handles), without overriding the Streams row template themselves. ## Performance Designed to stay cheap in large outlines: | Node state | Cost | | --- | --- | | Untyped | one `has[kind.type]` test; renders nothing | | Typed, collapsed | one pill (single field read, no type lookup) + an unopened `<$reveal>` | | Typed, expanded | full field bar — only for the nodes you expand | | Assigning | submenu in the context menu; type list renders only when the flyout opens | ## How it hooks in Streams renders each node's content through `$:/plugins/sq/streams/templates/stream-row-body`, a bare `<$transclude mode="block"/>` that bypasses `$:/core/ui/ViewTemplate`. This plugin ships its own copy of that template at `plugin-priority: 2` (Streams is `1`), so TiddlyWiki's shadow-precedence rules make it win. The override adds a cheap gate so only typed nodes render the extra component. No field or type logic is duplicated: the expanded bar transcludes kind's `stream-view`, and the assign submenu reuses kind's type filter (top-level types in the active namespace). ## Prerequisites - **kind** (required) — the type system, field bar and type picker. - **Streams** (required for the in-outline features). ## License MIT — see [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). "},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/doc/architecture":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/doc/architecture","rdt.order":"2","rdt.plugin-key":"kind-streams","rdt.plugin-name":"kind streams","rdt.section":"Architecture","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! The single hook point Streams renders every node's content through one template, `$:/plugins/sq/streams/templates/stream-row-body`, whose entire body is: ``` <$transclude mode="block"/> ``` That renders the node tiddler's own body in block mode. It does //not// pass through `$:/core/ui/ViewTemplate`, which is why kind's ViewTemplate-attached field bar never shows up inside a Streams outline. kind-streams ships its own copy of that template. The copy gates on a cheap `has[kind.type]` test and, for typed nodes only, transcludes the node bar //above// the body: ``` <%if [has[kind.type]] :filter[…enable…] %><$transclude $tiddler="…/node-bar"/><%endif%> <$transclude mode="block"/> ``` !! Winning the shadow Two plugins now define `stream-row-body`. TiddlyWiki assigns shadows by ascending `plugin-priority` (default 1), so the last writer wins. Streams is priority 1; kind-streams declares `plugin-priority: 2`, so its copy deterministically overrides. (A tie would break alphabetically — `rimir…` sorts before `sq…` and would //lose// — hence the explicit `2`.) !! Lazy rendering `node-bar` renders a cheap pill by default. The expensive field bar lives inside `<$reveal type="match" text="open">`, whose children are not rendered until the state tiddler `$:/state/rimir/kind-streams/open/` equals `open`. So the per-field iteration only runs for nodes the user expands. !! Reuse, not reimplementation * Expanded bar → transcludes kind's `stream-view` (needs `target-tid` in scope). * Assign submenu → reuses kind's type filter (`kind.top-level-types` + `kind.belongs-to-ns`), rendered with Streams' own `sq-contextmenu` markup so it matches the parent menu. Neither piece is duplicated here; this plugin only supplies the wiring, the lazy wrapper, and the CSS. !! Two overrides kind-streams overrides two Streams templates (both by `plugin-priority: 2`): * `stream-row-body` — injects the node bar above the node content (typed nodes only), preceded by every ''row add-on'' (below). * `contextmenu/contextmenu-template` — a faithful copy of the upstream menu with one added ''Kind type ▸'' flyout item (`contextmenu-kind-submenu`), using `tc-popup-keep` so the parent menu stays open. If a future Streams release changes either template, re-sync the copy. !! Row add-ons Other plugins can put something into every Streams row without overriding `stream-row-body` themselves (only one override of a shadow can win): tag a tiddler `$:/tags/rimir/kind-streams/row-addon` and it is transcluded at the start of each row's body, with `currentTiddler` = the node. Add-ons are rendered for every node, typed or not, and decide themselves whether to show anything. [[rimir/streams-ports|$:/plugins/rimir/streams-ports]] uses this for the port handles of stream rows. Type a node # In a Streams outline, right-click the node's drag handle. # Click ''Kind type ▸'' to open the flyout submenu. # Pick a type from the list (✓ marks the current one). The node now carries a `kind.type` field and shows a pill. !! Edit a typed node's fields # Click the pill on a typed node. # The type's stream-fields appear inline on the same row; click a field to edit it. # Use the ✎ toggle to switch between popup and inline editing; click ▾ to collapse. !! Turn the pills off Set `$:/config/rimir/kind-streams/enable` to `no` (or untick the box in the settings tab). Nodes render normally; you can still assign types from the right-click menu. !! Change which fields show inline The inline bar reuses kind's stream-fields for the type. Edit the type's `kind.stream-fields` (in kind's type builder) to control which fields appear — an empty list shows just the type pill. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/doc/faq":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/doc/faq","rdt.order":"4","rdt.plugin-key":"kind-streams","rdt.plugin-name":"kind streams","rdt.section":"FAQ","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! Does this slow down large outlines? Untyped nodes cost a single `has[kind.type]` test and render nothing extra. Typed nodes render one small pill; the full field bar is rendered lazily, only when you expand a node. The type submenu's list renders only when you open the flyout, never per node. !! Will it break when Streams updates? kind-streams overrides one Streams template (`stream-row-body`), which is a stable one-liner. If a future Streams version changes that template meaningfully, update this plugin's copy to match. The override wins by `plugin-priority`, independent of Streams' version. !! I don't see any pills. Check that: the node actually has a `kind.type` field; the enable toggle is on (`$:/config/rimir/kind-streams/enable`); and both kind and Streams are installed. Remember a server restart is needed after installing or editing the plugin. !! Can a stream node be a full kind instance? Yes — a typed node is a normal kind instance (a tiddler with `kind.type` and no `kind.fields`). It participates in kind's validator, graph, and cascade-palette surfaces like any other instance. !! How do I remove a type? Right-click → ''Kind type ▸'' → ''✕ Remove type'' in the submenu (or use the type pill inside the expanded bar). What it does ''kind streams'' lets a single [[Streams|$:/plugins/sq/streams]] node carry a [[kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] type. Once typed, the node is visually marked in the outline and its kind fields become editable in place — without opening the node as a separate tiddler. Three affordances: * ''Identify'' — a collapsed pill shows the node's `kind.type` key; a left accent marks the row. * ''Edit'' — expanding the pill renders kind's `stream-view` field bar for that node (lazily). * ''Assign'' — right-click → ''Kind type ▸'' opens a flyout submenu (styled like the Streams menu) listing the kind types. !! How it hooks in Streams renders each node's content through `$:/plugins/sq/streams/templates/stream-row-body`, which is a bare `<$transclude mode="block"/>` — it does //not// pass through `$:/core/ui/ViewTemplate`, so kind's ViewTemplate-attached field bar never appears inside the outline. This plugin ships its own copy of that template with a `plugin-priority: 2` (Streams is `1`), so TiddlyWiki's shadow-precedence rules make this copy win. The override adds a cheap gate: only nodes with a `kind.type` render the extra component. !! Performance model |!Node state |!Cost | |Untyped |one `has[kind.type]` test; renders nothing | |Typed, collapsed |one pill (single field read) + an unopened `<$reveal>` | |Typed, expanded |full `stream-view` field bar — only for opened nodes | |Assigning |submenu in the context menu; type list renders only when the flyout opens | !! Reuse No field-rendering or type logic is duplicated: the expanded bar transcludes kind's `stream-view`, and the assign submenu reuses kind's type filter (top-level types in the active namespace), rendered with Streams' own menu markup. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/readme","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"! kind streams Bridges [[Streams|$:/plugins/sq/streams]] and [[kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] so that individual Streams //nodes// can be turned into typed kind instances, marked as such, and edited — all without leaving the Streams outline. !! What it does * //Identify// — every Streams node that has a `kind.type` shows a small pill with its type key, right in the outline. A subtle accent marks the row. * //Edit in place// — click the pill to expand kind's compact field bar for that node (click a field to edit; toggle inline/popup). The bar is rendered ''lazily'', only for the node you open. * //Assign a type// — right-click any node → ''Kind type ▸'' opens a flyout submenu (styled like the Streams menu itself) listing the kind types; pick one to set, change (✓ marks the current) or remove its `kind.type`. //Extend rows// — other plugins can add something to every row by tagging a tiddler `$:/tags/rimir/kind-streams/row-addon` (used by [[rimir/streams-ports|$:/plugins/rimir/streams-ports]] for port handles), without overriding the Streams row template themselves. !! Performance This plugin is built to stay cheap in large outlines: * An //untyped// node costs one `has[kind.type]` test and renders nothing extra. * A //typed, collapsed// node renders one pill (a single field read — no type lookup) plus a `<$reveal>` whose contents are not rendered until opened. * The full, more expensive field bar renders only for the nodes you actually expand. * The type submenu renders inside the context menu, and its type list only when you open the flyout — never per node. !! Prerequisites * [[kind|$:/plugins/rimir/kind]] (required) — provides the type system, the field bar (`stream-view`) and the type picker. * [[Streams|$:/plugins/sq/streams]] (required for the in-outline features) — this plugin overrides one Streams template (`stream-row-body`) via a higher `plugin-priority`. !! Quick start # Install alongside kind and Streams. # Open a Streams outline and right-click a node → ''Kind type ▸'' → pick a type. # The node now shows a type pill. Click it to edit the type's fields inline. Everything can be turned off with the toggle in the [[settings|$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/settings]] tab. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/settings":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/settings","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim ! kind streams settings
<$checkbox tiddler="$:/config/rimir/kind-streams/enable" field="text" checked="yes" unchecked="no" default="yes">  ''Show the kind pill on typed Streams nodes'' When enabled, every Streams node that has a `kind.type` shows a collapsed type pill in the outline; expanding it reveals kind's field bar. When disabled, nodes render normally and you can still assign types via the right-click ''Kind type…'' menu. !! Related kind settings The in-node field bar reuses kind's own configuration: * `$:/config/rimir/kind/streambar-max-length` — max characters shown per field cell before truncation. * `$:/config/rimir/kind/active-namespace` — restricts which kind types the assign submenu offers.
"},"$:/plugins/sq/streams/templates/stream-row-body":{"title":"$:/plugins/sq/streams/templates/stream-row-body","text":"<$list filter="[all[shadows+tiddlers]tag[$:/tags/rimir/kind-streams/row-addon]!is[draft]]" variable="row-addon"><$transclude $tiddler=<>/><%if [has[kind.type]] :filter[[$:/config/rimir/kind-streams/enable]get[text]trim[]!match[no]] %><$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/node-bar"/><%endif%> <$transclude mode="block"/> "},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/styles":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-streams/styles","tags":"$:/tags/Stylesheet","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\rules except dash /* kind-streams — pill marker on typed Streams nodes + the kind-type submenu. No CSS custom properties are used, so the wikitext `dash` rule can't mangle any `--var`; `\rules except dash` is a defensive guard only. */ /* the bar sits as its own tight row ABOVE the node body */ .ks-node { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0; line-height: 1.2; } /* pull the node body (TW wraps it in a

with a theme top-margin) up snug against the bar */ .ks-node + p, .ks-node + ul, .ks-node + ol { margin-top: 0; } .ks-node-expanded { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } /* the expanded field bar carries its own margins in the story river; kill them when embedded in a stream node so it hugs the pill / node body */ .ks-node .kind-field-bar { margin: 0; } /* TW auto-wraps the block-mode transclusion of stream-view in

elements whose top/bottom margins open a gap above and below the field bar. display:contents removes those wrappers from layout entirely (their children flow directly into the .ks-node flex row) — same fix as the flibbles/graph

-wrapper gotcha. */ .ks-node p { display: contents; } /* collapsed pill — the cheap always-visible "this node is typed" marker */ .ks-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35em; font-size: 0.72em; line-height: 1; padding: 0.15em 0.55em; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(127,127,127,0.14); border: 1px solid <>; color: <>; opacity: 0.75; } .ks-pill:hover { opacity: 1; } .ks-pill-dot { width: 0.5em; height: 0.5em; border-radius: 50%; background: <>; display: inline-block; } .ks-collapse { font-size: 0.85em; opacity: 0.55; } /* subtle whole-row accent for typed nodes — pure CSS via :has(), no per-node widget cost. Streams renders .stream-node-control and .stream-node-block as siblings inside .stream-row; the pill lives deep in .stream-node-block. */ .stream-row:has(.ks-node-typed) > .stream-node-control { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 <>; } /* kind-type flyout submenu in the Streams context menu — inherits Streams' .sq-contextmenu / .tc-menu-list-item look. The submenu trigger row carries the ▸ affordance on the right. */ .ks-submenu > .tc-menu-list-item { width: 100%; } .ks-typemenu { max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; } "}}}
